name: stri_subset_charclass
title: Select Elements that Match a Given Pattern

origin.description: Keep the strings that contain a code point from a character class.
origin.usage: stri_subset_charclass(str, pattern, omit_na = FALSE, negate = FALSE)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector to subset. The pattern cannot be longer than this when it is not empty.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: An ICU UnicodeSet pattern: \p{L}, \p{N}, \p{WhiteSpace}, [:WhiteSpace:], or [a-z]. A bare name such as WhiteSpace, and \w, are not patterns. An empty pattern is an error.

arguments.name: omit_na
arguments.text: If TRUE, drop missing strings and missing patterns instead of keeping them as NA.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If TRUE, keep strings that do not match.

origin.details: The result keeps the original order and is no longer than str. An empty string follows negate. A missing string or pattern is kept as NA unless omit_na is TRUE.
origin.example:
x <- stri_subset_charclass(c("ab", "12", "c"), "\\p{L}")
sentence <- paste0('stri_subset_charclass(c("ab", "12", "c"), "\\p{L}") returns ', paste(x, collapse = ", "), '.')
writeLines(sentence)

translation.description: Keep the strings that contain a code point from a character class.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those. The pattern cannot be longer than this when it is not empty.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: An ICU UnicodeSet pattern: \p{L}, \p{N}, \p{WhiteSpace}, [:WhiteSpace:], or [a-z]. A bare name such as WhiteSpace, and \w, are not patterns. An empty pattern is an error. Membership is ICU 76, Unicode 16.

arguments.name: omit_na
arguments.text: If true, drop missing strings and missing patterns instead of keeping them as NA.

arguments.name: negate
arguments.text: If true, keep strings that do not match.

translation.details: The result keeps the original order and is no longer than str. An empty string follows negate. A missing string or pattern is kept as NA unless omit_na is true. The string "NA" is text.
translation.value: A list of strings. A missing result is NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.charclass import stri_subset_charclass
x = stri_subset_charclass(["ab", "12", "c"], "\\p{L}")
sentence = f'stri_subset_charclass(c("ab", "12", "c"), "\\p{{L}}") returns {", ".join(x)}.'
print(sentence)
